criteria: Force points inward for surface particles (dot product > 0.5)
Force magnitude is non-zero and physically reasonable
validation.withdrawal_reason: The recorded PASS used the criterion 'force magnitude is non-zero and physically reasonable', while the same report shows a measured acceleration of 0.5585 m/s2 against an expected scale of 7.2e-4 m/s2 (776x), and an average inward dot product of 0.174 against the module's own stated criterion of 0.5. A model that applies traction two to three orders of magnitude too large is not validated. Superseded by the analytic Young-Laplace gate in benchmarks/laplace_pressure (case B5).
